verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is AngelList's claim that you can "move your cap table to Stack within minutes", which implies some bulk import of existing cap table data, but the mechanism is not described. Equity Blocks (batch board pre-approval) and bulk e-sign (signing many documents at once) are adjacent features. They are not bulk issuance or upload of grants and transactions, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented bulk grant issuance, a spreadsheet/CSV upload for securities or historical transactions, details of how the cap table import works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
